title: Labor signals
subtitle: Time-clock records that may deserve a closer look. Signals are prompts for a person to review, not conclusions.

disclaimer.text: Signals highlight time-clock records worth a second look. They are not legal conclusions and do not say that any law was or was not followed. Rules depend on facts this app cannot see, so confirm anything important with qualified employment counsel. [COUNSEL] [VERIFY]
disclaimer.verify: [VERIFY] Numbers not yet compared with the source

daily_hours_above_threshold.title: Long day on record
daily_hours_above_threshold.detail: {{hours}} clocked hours in one day, above the {{threshold}}-hour daily threshold set in Rules.

weekly_hours_above_threshold.title: Long week on record
weekly_hours_above_threshold.detail: {{hours}} clocked hours in the workweek, above the {{threshold}}-hour weekly threshold set in Rules.

payroll_overtime_below_clock.title: Payroll overtime lower than the clock
payroll_overtime_below_clock.detail: Clock records show about {{clockHours}} hours above your configured thresholds that week. Payroll lists {{payrollHours}} overtime hours.

seventh_day_clocked.title: Time on all seven days
seventh_day_clocked.detail: Time is recorded on every day of the workweek that starts {{weekStart}}.

open_shift_long.title: Shift open for a long time
open_shift_long.detail: A shift has been open for {{hours}} hours (alert after {{threshold}}). A clock-out may have been missed.

classification_with_clock_use.title: Time clock used by a worker recorded differently
classification_with_clock_use.detail: {{shifts}} clocked shifts this month for a worker with this record: {{classificationLabel}}. Worth checking that the record is current.

pw_classification_missing.title: No classification on a wage-table job
pw_classification_missing.detail: {{hours}} hours across {{jobs}} job(s) that use a wage table, with no classification recorded for this worker.

pw_pay_below_table.title: Recorded pay below the wage table
pw_pay_below_table.detail: Recorded pay of {{paid}} per hour is lower than the table rate of {{table}} per hour for the recorded classification ({{hours}} hours that day).

break_meal_missing.title: No meal break on record
break_meal_missing.detail: {{workedMinutes}} minutes worked with no meal break on record.

break_meal_late.title: Meal break started late
break_meal_late.detail: A meal break was recorded after the point set in your break rules ({{workedMinutes}} minutes worked).

break_rest_missing.title: Rest break missing on record
break_rest_missing.detail: Fewer rest breaks are on record than your break rules list ({{workedMinutes}} minutes worked).

review.title: Review this signal
review.notePlaceholder: For your own records. Avoid sensitive personal details.
review.reopen: Mark as needing a look again
review.counselHint: "Sent to counsel" only records that you passed it on. Nothing is sent from here.

workers.heading: Worker records
workers.intro: This is what your business has recorded. Vireek does not decide or verify anyone's status. Hour-based signals are skipped for workers recorded as exempt or as contractors; a separate worker-record signal appears if they use the time clock.
workers.basisPlaceholder: e.g. where this record came from
workers.readOnly: You can view these records but not change them.
workers.empty: No active employees yet. Add employees under Payroll to record how each worker is classified.
workers.excluded: Hour-based signals are skipped for {{count}} worker(s) because of the record shown here.

rules.heading: Rules used for signals
rules.intro: Pick a starter set, adjust the numbers, then record when counsel reviewed it and when someone compared it with the source. Changing the numbers clears both records.
rules.notConfigured: Not set up. No signals are produced for this topic until you save a rule set.
rules.saved: Rules saved. Earlier review records were cleared because the numbers changed.
rules.lastReviewedNone: Starter set not yet compared with its source

overtime.heading: Hours and overtime thresholds
overtime.seventh: Signal when all seven days of a workweek have clocked time

prevailing_wage.heading: Wage-table data checks
prevailing_wage.missing: Time on wage-table jobs with no classification recorded
prevailing_wage.below: Recorded pay lower than the wage-table rate

review.heading: Review records
review.verified: Date the numbers were compared with the source
review.hint: This records what a person did. Vireek does not check the law.

breaks.heading: Meal and rest breaks
breaks.body: Break signals use the rules on the Break Compliance page, which has its own review workflow.

states.emptyBody: Nothing in the time-clock records matches the rules you set up for this period.
states.emptyNoRulesBody: No overtime or wage-table rules are saved yet, so only worker-record and break signals can appear. Open the Rules tab to choose a starter set.
states.noAccessTitle: You do not have access to labor signals
states.noAccessBody: Ask the account owner to give you billing access.
states.truncated: This period has more shifts than can be shown at once. Choose a shorter period for complete results.

errors.permission: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.invalid: Some of the values are not valid. Check the numbers and try again.
errors.notFound: That item no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
